notes.title: Update Patch 1.3.5
notes.notes:
First off, don't let the size of the update fool you, I changed a couple of models and had to re-bake the lightmaps, hence there is around 73MB update. But it mostly contains fixes.

[b]If you have previous progress, I highly recommend starting a new game instead so that all these fixes can properly propagate to the checkpoints feature.[/b]

Fixes:
[list]
    [*]Environment clipping should work fine
    [*]Interactions (that allowed this previously) can no longer be triggered through the wall
    [*]Yard fence should no longer let the player go through
    [*]Removed the scaffolding diagonal pole (to avoid any remaining confusion)
    [*]The state of the game should be restored correctly upon loading from checkpoint
    [*]Hopefully, falling through the ground upon load should be no issue any more
    [*]Updated character models
[/list]

Known issues still present:
[list]
    [*]Flashlight resets upon loading from checkpoint - my recommendation, avoid picking it back up :)
    [*]The player will go through the stairway if crouching under and standing up - my recommendation, don't crouch under the stairway :)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch 1.3.2
notes.notes:
The latest patch adds requested features and fixes more of the reported bugs.

Added features:
[list]
    [*]Mouse can be inverted (Settings -> Controls -> Mouse)
    [*]Keys to all actions can be re-mapped
    [*]Global volume controls (Settings -> Gameplay)
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
    [*]Collisions should appear correctly now
    [*]Wirecutter should not crawl on the floor after load anymore
    [*]Wirecutter minigame should now work correctly
[/list]

Experimental (I was not able to reproduce, but made a few changes):
[list]
    [*]Keys should no longer disappear after opening the garage door
    [*]The scaffolding should work fine now
[/list]

Note: The diagonal rod resting against the scaffolding is really NOT to be climbed. It is not a bug if you fall down from it.

notes.title: Update Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
I have compiled a list of fixes that address issues and bugs that the players have been experiencing since release.

These include:
[list]
    [*]No more rod jumping to climb the scaffolding
    [*]Flashlight, if equipped, should no longer hang in the air
    [*]Added restriction to block the character from entering undefined space
    [*]Garage floor should no longer let go
    [*]No more jumping on items the player should not reach
    [*]Floating shadow of picked items is gone
    [*]The title menu should no longer start without the sound
[/list]

There is another patch 1.3.2 coming soon to add requested features, like inverted mouse or full key re-binding options.
